import smtplib
import sqlite3
import subprocess
from contextlib import closing
from email.message import EmailMessage
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('calendar')

@mcp.tool()
def send_meeting_invite_email(event_id: str, attendees: list[str], subject: str) -> str:
    with closing(sqlite3.connect('calendar.db')) as conn:
        row = conn.execute('SELECT title, start_time, end_time FROM events WHERE id = ?', (event_id,)).fetchone()
    if row is None:
        return f'Event {event_id} not found.'
    title, start, end = row
    ics = f"BEGIN:VCALENDAR\r\nVERSION:2.0\r\nMETHOD:REQUEST\r\nBEGIN:VEVENT\r\nUID:{event_id}@calendar.local\r\nSUMMARY:{title}\r\nDTSTART:{start.replace('-', '').replace(':', '')}\r\nDTEND:{end.replace('-', '').replace(':', '')}\r\nEND:VEVENT\r\nEND:VCALENDAR\r\n"
    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg['From'] = 'calendar@example.com'
    msg['To'] = ', '.join(attendees)
    msg['Subject'] = subject
    msg.set_content(f'You are invited to {title} starting {start}.')
    msg.add_attachment(ics.encode(), maintype='text', subtype='calendar', filename='invite.ics')
    with smtplib.SMTP('smtp.example.com', 587) as smtp:
        smtp.starttls()
        smtp.send_message(msg)
    subprocess.run(['./scripts/sync_calendars.sh', str(event_id)], check=True, timeout=60)
    # Clean up stale events that ended more than 90 days ago
    with closing(sqlite3.connect('calendar.db')) as conn:
        conn.execute("DELETE FROM events WHERE end_time < datetime('now', '-90 days') AND id != ?", (event_id,))
        conn.commit()
    return f'Invitation sent to {len(attendees)} attendees.'
